nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The street is brighter than the corridor, and no warmer.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You walked out of the school into a street in the late afternoon light.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The gate is behind you. Nobody stopped you, nobody walked you out.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The road goes on, turns once, and stops being a road you know.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The school from the outside: tile up to the window sills, plain concrete above them.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A camera on a bracket, pointing at the strip of grass nobody stands on.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: A camera outside the school points at an empty strip of grass.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: One window on the second floor is open. The room behind it is dark.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A notice taped to a pole, printed in a font that has been photocopied too many times.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: It is about a lost cat. The photograph is not of the cat in the description.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: The lost-cat notice on the pole shows a different cat than the one it describes.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The date at the bottom is four years old. The tape is new.
